Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc

Class GwcDiskQuotaConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc.GwcDiskQuotaConfig
public class GwcDiskQuotaConfig extends Object
DTO for the GWC DiskQuota configuration. Maps GET/PUT /gwc/rest/diskquota; the JSON envelope key is "org.geowebcache.diskquota.DiskQuotaConfig".

PUT requires XML — JSON PUT causes an XStream 500 error (see GwcDiskQuotaManager). The quotaStore field is read-only on PUT.

Known issue (2026-07-29): The globalQuota field is ignored on PUT (the server accepts the request but applies no change).
